searchText: Today during FOCIL breakout #16, I'll do a presentation on ePBS and FOCIL compatibility, going into what the slot structure looks like if you ship both Link to post: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/epbs-focil-compatibility/24777 Link to agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1646 Stream at YT: https://youtube.com/live/E5VY5LgEEk8?feature=share X: https://x.com/i/broadcasts/1djxXVrLvwyGZ Zoom: Zoom Link: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/84265745580?pwd=bfFrSkautyZYvMqkX1dl6otyJnoCvy.1 You can lock down the room via zoom settings just open a new link we're all here Suspend participant activities amazing how people have time to waste which is the new zoom link? Join Zoom Meeting https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81433312031?pwd=OxURzIUN5u9lzzKw6S6FMs1fCRcoDa.1 Meeting ID: 814 3331 2031 Passcode: 739464 We need CR to presentation censorship One take away from the call is we might want to remove `parentHash` from `engine_getInclusionListV1`, such that to build an inclusion list, just give me a list of censored txs based on your subjective view vs a list of txs + valid on top of this parent hash. This reason we want to do this for epbs is because PTC deadlne for blob will always be later than IL submission deadline, so using `parentHash` in epbs would likely always be a slot delayed. Without `parentHash` you could at least import txs more timely and just rely on attesters to filter them out cc <@845691100072509460> <@725415098331430932> reference: https://github.com/jihoonsong/execution-apis/blob/1c22e31fb7ffab128e48ba2b0b6da9d469382bbe/src/engine/experimental/eip7805.md#engine_getinclusionlistv1 Recording: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gjWReOSaT-o

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content:
One take away from the call is we might want to remove `parentHash` from `engine_getInclusionListV1`, such that to build an inclusion list, just give me a list of censored txs based on your subjective view vs a list of txs + valid on top of this parent hash. 

This reason we want to do this for epbs is because PTC deadlne for blob will always be later than IL submission deadline, so using `parentHash` in epbs would likely always be a slot delayed. Without `parentHash` you could at least import txs more timely and just rely on attesters to filter them out
